# taba_topic (Data Source)

Reads one topic by name: a queue, a distributor or a dead-letter queue, managed here or not. The token needs to reach the name (its prefixes).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A queue another team created, and its dead-letter queue.
data "taba_topic" "orders" {
  name = "orders"
}

data "taba_topic" "orders_dead_letter" {
  name = "orders-dead-letter"
}

output "orders_ttl" {
  value = data.taba_topic.orders.effective_ttl
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the topic (a dead-letter queue too).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `dead_letter` (Boolean) True on a dead-letter queue.
- `effective_max_deliveries` (Number) The max_deliveries in force.
- `effective_max_message_bytes` (Number) The max_message_bytes in force.
- `effective_ttl` (Number) The ttl in force.
- `fifo` (Boolean) FIFO queue.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the topic.
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Volatile queue only: seconds without a consumer until removal.
- `max_deliveries` (Number) Declared deliveries before the dead-letter (null: the node default).
- `max_message_bytes` (Number) Declared maximum message size (null: the node default).
- `prefixes` (List of String) Distributor only: the destination prefixes (null on a queue).
- `source` (String) Dead-letter queue only: the queue it belongs to.
- `tags` (Map of String) Telemetry tags.
- `ttl` (Number) Declared message lifetime, in seconds (null: the node default).
- `type` (String) `queue` or `distributor`.
- `volatile` (Boolean) Volatile queue.
